player_prompt.intro:
Kai dan wasa ne {player_id} yana wasa wasan Pig Dice.

Ka'idoji:
- A lokacin da ka zo, za ka iya '[roll]' ko '[hold]'
- Kururu 2-6: Ƙara wa jimillar ka
- Kururu 1: Rasa jimillar ka kuma ƙare ka
- Hold: Ƙara jimillar ka zuwa maki ka kuma ƙare ka
- Na farko ya zuwa {winning_score} maki ya yi nasara

Lokacin da ka zo, za ka ga maki na jimillar yanzu.
Amsa da '[roll]' domin kururu ko '[hold]' domin adana maki ka.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Tsarin aiki mara inganci. Yi amfani da "[roll]" ko "[hold]".

actions.player_busted: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya fashe, ya rasa {turn_total} maki!
actions.player_hold: Dan wasa {player_id} ya riƙe kuma ya adana {turn_total} maki.

board.current_total_scores: Jimlar maki na yanzu: {scores} Jimlar jujjuyawar ku ta yanzu ita ce {turn_total} .
board.roll_history: {observation} Tarihin jujjuyawar ku don wannan juyawa: {roll_history}
board.first_roll: {observation} Wannan shi ne karo na farko da za ka yi.
board.available_actions: {observation} Ayyukan da ake da su: "[roll]" ko "[hold]"

outcome.winner_by_score: Dan wasa {winner_id} ya yi nasara ta hanyar kaiwa maki {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: An kai iyakar juyawa kuma duk 'yan wasan suna da maki iri ɗaya: {scores}
